craft_notes: Sthāyin: ground-taking. Rows: strew then gather. Read aloud: compass rite.

lines: Then the said weapon-muttered white grain and the rest, splendour-formed,
having strewn, in the north-east quarter gather in order —
l4.sanskrit_cite: tata uktāstrajaptāni yathāsambhavaṃ siddhārthadhānyākṣatalājādīni tejorūpāṇi vikīrya aiśānyāṃ diśi krameṇa saṃghaṭṭayet iti bhūparigrahaḥ
